scripts.build: bun build index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --minify && bun build public/js/app.js --outdir dist/public/js --target browser --minify && bun build public/modules/*.js --outdir dist/public/modules --target browser --minify && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('public/index.html','dist/public/index.html',{force:true}); fs.cpSync('public/css','dist/public/css',{recursive:true,force:true});"
